description: This file defines the ProfileProvider class for managing user profile data, including authentication state handling, profile retrieval, and updates in a Firebase-backed Angular application.

classes.name: ProfileProvider
classes.description: Angular service class for managing user profile data and interactions with Firebase database.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Returns reference to the user's profile in Firebase database.

methods.name: getUserOtherProfile
methods.description: Returns reference to the user's associated driver profile.

methods.name: getUserAsClientInfo
methods.description: Returns reference to the client's profile data.

methods.name: getAllDrivers
methods.description: Returns reference to all drivers in the database.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the user's first and last name in their profile.

methods.name: RateDriver
methods.description: Sets whether the client has rated a specific driver.

methods.name: ApprovePickup
methods.description: Sets pickup approval status for a client.

methods.name: ApproveDrop
methods.description: Sets drop-off approval status for a client.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a client.

methods.name: CanCharge
methods.description: Sets whether the client can charge their card.
